title: Stamp Trade-Out Candidates by Duplicate Count
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stamp:item
| stats count(eval(duplicate=true)) as duplicates count as stamps by country
| sort 0 - duplicates
description: Ranks countriess by duplicate stamp count.
value: A trade-out list turns duplicate accumulation into a practical next action instead of shelf clutter.
implementation: Send duplicate stamp count events to `index=personal` and keep `country` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of duplicate stamp count by countries.
grandmaExplanation: It builds which countriess stand out most for duplicate stamp count.
